name: 1fi-emi-app-root
description: 1Fi EMI App root scripts for running backend and frontend simultaneously

scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'preview'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
